4289-4770-6090-6791.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1021-6303-6620.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving a creature shroud until end of turn.
Repeat.

4687-4929-6723.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
4687-4929-6723.description:
Activate A Realm Reborn by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

767-1284-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-1284-4687.description:
Activate Viridian Longbow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1479-2443-2841-4862.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-4862.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1286-5972-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-5972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1011-2728-2921-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-2921-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-2921-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

277-1308-3129-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2292-7084-7889.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7831-7834.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7831-7834.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Chameleon each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-6478-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-6791.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

772-3175-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

215-1336-3464.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2459-4053-5147-6989.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

4929-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1322-2034-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2633-3940-4146.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Haze of Rage's storm ability, Blood Funnel and Murmuring Mystic trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Murmuring Mystic trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

252-4871-6791.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-6791.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

215-4010-5295-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {3}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-5295-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2136-4050-4906-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four extra nonlegendary creatures.
2136-4050-4906-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy the Jolly Balloon Man ability targeting each other creature the ability can target.
Resolve all Jolly Balloon Man abilities, creating a token copy of each other creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste. As needed, put the oldest Agrus Kos and Orthion into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four tokens except the Orthion or Agrus Kos tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate the Orthion token's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, targeting the Agrus Kos token.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy the Orthion ability targeting each other creature the ability can target.
Resolve all Orthion abilities, creating a token copy of each other creature you control with haste. As needed, put the oldest Agrus Kos and Jolly Balloon Man into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing four tokens except the Orthion or Agrus Kos tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

944-4484-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-4484-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-4484-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

413-2882-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
413-2882-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
413-2882-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2279-2292-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3528-3976-5437.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3528-3976-5437.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Rise of the Eldrazi.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{R}{B}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the 3/3 creature that has Rise of the Eldrazi noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.
3528-3976-5437.notes: The discard outlet is provided as a method of getting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard, as it does not go to the graveyard after resolution. You can substitute any other method for this, including using mill or other techniques.

225-1479-2692-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-2692-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1558-5395.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Piper Wright.
Piper Wright has power 5 or greater.
1558-5395.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Piper Wright.
Piper Wright's first ability triggers, creating at least five Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Clues.
Piper Wright's second ability triggers five times, putting five +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2060-2567-2893-4482-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Plant" chosen with Conspiracy.
2060-2567-2893-4482-4875.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Avenger of Zendikar's second ability triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

229-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
229-5220-5243.description:
Cast Endless One either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

690-1612.description:
Cast Shard of the Nightbringer by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Shard of the Nightbringer triggers, causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life gained this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2232-2459-3604-5231.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2232-2459-3604-5231.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or the command zone by paying {0} and commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cadric and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Rograkh with haste.
The Rograkh token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Rograkh token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1869-2721-3719.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Inalla.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Inalla.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice Bloodline Necromancer and create three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
The Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer and create two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Inalla trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
The Bloodline Necromancer token enters the battlefield, returning Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
If Inalla is not on the battlefield, activate an appropriate number of Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Inalla from the command zone.
If needed, cast Inalla from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Inalla by tapping five untapped Wizards you control, causing target player to lose 7 life.
Repeat step 14.

186-3007-4131.notablePrerequisites:
Toymaker and Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
186-3007-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Toymaker by paying {1}, tapping it, and discarding a card, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt's Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

614-1987-3075-4792.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
614-1987-3075-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Nucklavee, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
